checks.check: The written territory pack, responsive comparison board, and static overview image exist under outputs/v0.
The pack records the 1998 founding fact, Chinese-pastry category, 30–45 core audience, 22–30 growth audience, and gifting requirement.
Seven brief/reference/channel conflicts are stated with an explicit handling principle.
Ten hypotheses (H01–H10) are present, each includes a risk, and every hypothesis maps exactly once into T1, T2, or T3.
Exactly three territories are defined with different primary drivers, composition grammars, photography logic, and failure criteria.
T1, T2, and T3 each use a separate four-color primary palette; no palette hex value is shared across territories.
No Logo redraw or edit was created. Low-cost thumbnails use text-only placeholders marked as the existing Logo, and the written pack locks the existing structure and Chinese name.

Reference A contributes hierarchy/close-up principles, Reference B contributes controlled system logic, and Reference C contributes only secondary friendliness/line-language principles; no reference Logo, icon, or layout is reproduced.
Every territory includes explicit Taobao hero/detail/SKU logic and physical-store wall, display, signage, or wayfinding logic.
The 20,770-byte HTML fragment parsed with Python html.parser, contains 10 hypothesis cards and 3 territory cards, and includes responsive reflow rules at 880 px and 420 px.
The 1800 × 2480 PNG was inspected at original detail: all sections are visible, the three thumbnail systems are distinguishable, and no content is clipped.
The pack stops at the requested checkpoint and does not select, hybridize, or refine a territory on the client's behalf.

unresolved_blockers.detail: Client selection of T1, T2, or T3 is required before refinement and Friday proposal executions.
